sketch:
Observe: SVG canvas with a horizontal current-carrying rod immersed
in a uniform B field (represented by ⊙/⊗ symbols on the page plane).
Sliders: current I (A), rod length ℓ (cm), field |B| (mT), angle α
between I and B. Force vector F drawn on the rod using
F = I·ℓ·B·sin(α), direction by right-hand rule. HUD shows |F|, α.
Right-hand-rule helper: three-finger diagram updates live.
Experiment: adjust I, α to reach target |F|. Evaluate: force arrow
hidden; student picks parameters to match target |F| and direction
(checked on submit). Wrinkle: sin(α) dependence is the pedagogical
hook; unit chain A·m·T = N.
